If you can succeed at that, attempt to go south. If you can get through with that, attempt to take a trip west. Following that, ensure that the door is open. And then, travel west. After that, check that the gateway is unlocked with the latchkey. Then, doublecheck that the gateway is open. After that, go west. After that, try to go north. With that accomplished, attempt to travel north. Next, make an effort to venture north. And then, lift the pair of headphones from the floor of the cellar. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
